Sublime food , great service. Lovely little unpretentious restaurant

Sublime, fresh , carefully prepared, well executed, we had sashimi as well as maki , gyoza , octopus balls , seaweed salad and miso soup and honestly I could not fault it. Recommend this place highly, and the bill was reasonable for what we had.
